definitions.explanation: A neckline cut in the shape of a V at the front, or a garment with such a neckline, such as a V-neck sweater or T-shirt.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧Vネック⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦セーター→セーター：01371_seetaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: In winter I often wear V-neck sweaters.

examples.japanese: Vネック⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}く→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧まわり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦すっきり→すっきり：05180_sukkiri⟧⟦させたい→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧だ。
examples.english: V-necks make the neck look longer, so they're popular with people who want a cleaner look around the face.

notes:
From English "V-neck," written with the Latin letter V and read ぶい. Mostly used before ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ to describe a garment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- Vネック⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦セーター→セーター：01371_seetaa⟧: a V-neck sweater
- {深|ふか}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧Vネック: a deep V-neck

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦クルーネック→クルーネック：33923_kuruunekku⟧: crew neck — a round neckline close to the neck
- ⟦{丸首|まるくび}→丸首：33918_marukubi⟧: round neck
